groups.name: zero-trust.secrets
groups.description: Secret resolution for outbound service tokens. Pluggable via VaultStyleSecretBackend (SPI).

groups.name: zero-trust.secrets.vault
groups.description: Inline Vault-style backend that reads secrets from YAML. Replaceable with a real HashiCorp Vault (or AWS/Azure) backend by providing a custom VaultStyleSecretBackend bean.

properties.name: zero-trust.secrets.enabled
properties.description: Enable secret resolution. When false, no VaultStyleSecretResolver bean is created.

properties.name: zero-trust.secrets.vault.enabled
properties.description: Enable the built-in InlineVaultStyleSecretBackend. Disable if you register a custom backend.

properties.name: zero-trust.secrets.vault.entries
properties.description: Inline secret entries. Each entry has a path and either a (key, value) pair or a values map.
